page: Helpers are utility functions for application development, unlike middleware they don't act as handlers but provide useful functionality. Cookie helper example: getCookie(c, 'cookie_name'), setCookie(c, 'cookie_name', 'value'). Available helpers: Accepts, Adapter, Cookie, css, Dev, Factory, html, JWT, SSG, Streaming, Testing, WebSocket. Each helper addresses specific use cases. Import from hono/<helper_name>. Questions: What are helpers vs middleware? Which helpers are available? How do I use the cookie helper? Where do I import helpers from?
